subject: NorthForge MSA & DPA - redline coordination and SCCs role clarification
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northforge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Walsh <tom.walsh@northforge.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NorthForge MSA & DPA - redlines and evidence

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for sending the MSA and order form — we reviewed the latest and attached a tracked redline (northforge_redlines_v2.docx). There are three items blocking our legal signoff:

- SCCs: we need confirmation that the standard SCCs will be executed and which party will be the data exporter/processor in the signing language.
- KMS & key custody: our security team requires a short note on whether Redwood will support customer-managed keys for the dedicated/private offering.
- Evidence for subprocessor routing: our privacy lead asked for an evidence manifest that maps processing activities to regions.

Can your team get us a concise DPA redline and an evidence manifest this week? If it's easier we can hop on a 30-minute call — Tom and I are available Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Attachments: northforge_redlines_v2.docx

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Legal, NorthForge Inc.
elena.ruiz@northforge.com

----
Note: forwarding this to Jonas rather than vendor legal to pick the right Redwood owner for KMS/hosting answers.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthForge MSA & DPA - redlines and evidence

Thanks Elena — appreciate the clear redline. Quick update and proposed next steps: 

1) DPA redline: attached a concise comment file (RF-DPA-comments.pdf) that maps your redline items to the standard DPA clauses we use. Major note: the SCCs text we propose is the most-recent EU Commission module and we propose Redwood as processor and NorthForge as controller in the signature block (we can flip if your counsel prefers otherwise).

2) Evidence manifest: attached evidence_manifest.csv — it lists where data is processed (region), which subprocessor, and whether KMS is required. This should help your security team triage.

3) KMS: short answer — customer-managed keys are supported for Redwood Private and Dedicated in our roadmap; for hosted we offer Bring-Your-Own-Key via our KMS integration (we'll provide the technical note).

4) Order form impact: Ben will call out any pricing or SLA changes if you accept a Private deployment or a KMS surcharge.

Proposed meeting: Tue 23 Mar 2027 09:00 PST — 30 minutes to walk through SCCs and signoff path. I've attached a short agenda (dpa-review-agenda.md). Laura, could you confirm whether Legal wants any language changes beyond the blue-line comments?

Attachments: RF-DPA-comments.pdf, evidence_manifest.csv, dpa-review-agenda.md

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthForge MSA & DPA - redlines and evidence

Elena — quick commercial and ops note from my side:

- If NorthForge needs the KMS option on Dedicated/Private, that will change the order form pricing and lead time. I attached orderform_impact_notes.txt with the delta estimates.
- For SCCs: we can accept the standard modules, but any controller/processor signature swaps we should capture in a short transfer impact addendum (TIA). Laura, can you advise whether the TIA should be an appendix or a standalone addendum?
- If NorthForge needs guaranteed EU-only token routing, we need to flag a routing SLA (minor uplift).

I recommend we keep the legal redline cadence separate from commercial pricing approvals — Jonas/Laura and Elena, if you confirm the legal language this week, I can start the PO/pricing thread so procurement can queue the PO.

Attachments: orderform_impact_notes.txt

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthForge MSA & DPA - redlines and evidence

Thanks all — that was helpful. A couple quick confirmations following the agenda we walked through: 

- SCCs/signature: NorthForge prefers to remain controller; we will sign the SCCs in that configuration. We will accept Redwood's processor wording in the DPA as long as you add the short transfer impact addendum language to cover fallback routing.
- KMS path: NorthForge will proceed with Dedicated + customer-managed key option. Ben — we accept the surcharge estimate in your notes; please send an updated order form.
- Evidence: your manifest looks good, our security team will send a one-page validation checklist by EOD Wednesday.

Next steps:
- I'll route the blue-line to our procurement and send a DocuSign envelope for the MSA + order form once we have the updated pricing.
- Laura (Redwood) — if you can push the final redline with the TIA language by EOD Wed we can try to close by the end of the week.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=7a8b9c

Attachments: SCCs_signed_template.pdf

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Legal, NorthForge Inc.
elena.ruiz@northforge.com
